R4D-deer-atv-0002.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R4D-deer-atv-0002.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Ponderosa FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: Mule deer winter range u-4-001 unit 160 (official), right here. Counts from October.
Cutblock harvested 2013 (13 years old), 910 m NW.
Burn from 2021 (fire N51705, 5,953 ha), 930 m SE.
S facing slope, 26 degrees: sun melts snow first.
Private fields 1.3 km W: deer feed on field edges (fields are private).

flags.t: Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: 4 point bucks: antlers must accompany the species licence

plan: Drive: from Village of Nakusp, about 85 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 6 (E Hwy 6), Hwy 6, Hwy 6 (Union St).
Park: 49.70665, -117.47484, where the truck road ends (Ponderosa FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 2.7 km on Ponderosa Creek FSR by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 70 m E, climb about 28 m.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2013 cutblock (910 m NW) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-17, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R4D-deer-atv-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 4-17: about 1,204 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.71 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.1 km and about 28 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
